papers.title: Effects of Cryopreservation on Cell Metabolic Activity and Function of Biofabricated Structures Laden with Osteoblasts.
papers.abstract: Biofabrication and maturation of bone constructs is a long-term task that requires a high degree of specialization. This specialization falls onto the hierarchy complexity of the bone tissue that limits the transfer of this technology to the clinic. This work studied the effects of the short-term cryopreservation on biofabricated osteoblast-containing structures, with the final aim to make them steadily available in biobanks. The biological responses studied include the osteoblast post-thawing metabolic activity and the recovery of the osteoblastic function of 3D-bioprinted osteoblastic structures and beta tricalcium phosphate (β-TCP) scaffolds infiltrated with osteoblasts encapsulated in a hydrogel. The obtained structures were cryopreserved at -80 °C for 7 days using dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) as cryoprotectant additive. After thawing the structures were cultured up to 14 days. The results revealed fundamental biological aspects for the successful cryopreservation of osteoblast constructs. In summary, immature osteoblasts take longer to recover than mature osteoblasts. The pre-cryopreservation culture period had an important effect on the metabolic activity and function maintain, faster recovering normal values when cryopreserved after longer-term culture (7 days). The use of β-TCP scaffolds further improved the osteoblast survival after cryopreservation, resulting in similar levels of alkaline phosphatase activity in comparison with the non-preserved structures. These results contribute to the understanding of the biology of cryopreserved osteoblast constructs, approaching biofabrication to the clinical practice.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究生物打印结构的冷冻保存，未涉及任何人工智能方法，与研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No AI/ML integration, no autonomous decision-making, no experimental validation of AI model.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究冷冻保存对生物打印成骨细胞结构的影响，以便临床应用。
summary_zh.method: 使用DMSO冷冻保存3D打印结构，培养后检测代谢活性和功能。
summary_zh.result: 未成熟成骨细胞恢复较慢，β-TCP支架提高存活率。

summary_en.motivation: Investigate cryopreservation effects on biofabricated osteoblast constructs for clinical translation.
summary_en.method: Cryopreserved 3D-bioprinted and scaffold-seeded constructs with DMSO, then cultured and assayed.
summary_en.result: Immature osteoblasts recover slower; β-TCP scaffolds improve survival and function.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell metabolic and functional assays.
